avians.name: Crispy Moth

avians.name: Yoghurt Champ
avians.effect: Each Pal Crit increases its Final Crit DMG by 2%, stacking up to 5 times. Each Pal Combo increases its Final Combo DMG by 2%, stacking up to 5 times.

avians.name: Astronaut Pinky
avians.effect: Deals 675% Basic ATK AoE DMG every 16s and gains a shield equal to 10% of Max HP for 6s.

avians.name: Maniac Love
avians.effect: Fire Cupid's Arrows at random targets every 5s (triggers at the start of the battle). If the target is oneself, reduce DEF by 30% and convert 3 time(s) of the reduced DEF into ATK for 5s. If the target is an enemy, deal 165% of AoE Skill DMG, 70% of current AoE Combo DMG (can be Crit), and 70% of current AoE Counter DMG (can be Crit) and reduce their Final DMG RES by 10% for 5s.

avians.name: Dream Moment
avians.effect: Gain a shield that absorbs 6% of Max HP every 12s, lasting for 6s. After a shield expires, deal 320% of AoE Skill DMG, 120% of current AoE Combo DMG, and 120% of current AoE Counter DMG and increase ATK SPD by 20% for 6s. (Triggers at the start of the battle.)

avians.name: Pet - Genos
avians.effect: Every 15s after the battle starts, all enemies take 360% Skill DMG, 120% current Basic ATK DMG (can be Crit), 120% current Combo DMG (can be Crit), and 120% current Counter DMG (can be Crit) 5 times and lose 50% DEF for 5s (cannot be cleansed).

avians.name: Anubis
avians.effect: Deals 765% Skill DMG, 305% of current Combo DMG, and 305% of current Counter DMG every 15s after battle starts and reduces the target's ATK by 15% for 5s. (Triggers at the start of the battle.)

avians.name: Midnight Firefly
avians.effect: Deal 240% of current Basic ATK DMG every 16s after battle starts and reduce the target's DMG RES by 15% for 5 seconds. Deal 600% Skill DMG, 240% of current Combo DMG, and 240% of current Counter DMG again after a short delay. (Triggers at start of the battle.)

avians.name: Moonbound Spirit
avians.effect: Deals 300% Skill DMG, 120% current Combo DMG, and 120% current Counter DMG every 5s after battle starts, with a 50% chance to deal extra DMG equal to 3% of the target's Max HP. (Triggers at the start of the battle.)

avians.name: Horus, Sky God
avians.effect: Every 6s, deals 240% Skill DMG, 100% of current Combo DMG, 100% of current Counter DMG, plus an amount equal to 2% of the target's current HP. After every 3 casts, deals an additional 480% Skill DMG, 200% of current Combo DMG, and 200% of current Counter DMG and directly defeats the target if its HP is below 5%, after which dealing DMG equal to 2% of the target's Max HP per second for 3s. (Triggers at the start of the battle.)

avians.name: Magic Cat
avians.effect: Every 15s, deals 765% Skill DMG, 305% of current Combo DMG, and 305% of current Counter DMG and activates Feline Magic 5 times within 2s, each time reducing the cooldown of a random Active Skill by 2s. This prioritizes skills in cooldown and can be used on the same skill repeatedly. (Triggers 1s after the start of the battle.)

avians.name: Puppy Gaze
avians.effect: Every 15s, deals 765% Skill DMG, 305% of current Combo DMG, and 305% of current Counter DMG and increases Pal ATK SPD by 50% for 5s. (Triggers at the start of the battle.)

avians.name: Deity of Purrs
avians.effect: For every 16 times healed (including HP regen, healing, active skill and healing effects of passive skills, Lifesteal of Spectral Chant excluded), deals DMG equal to 4% of current HP to targets within the range.

avians.name: Michelle
avians.effect: For every 50 instances of damage taken, enemies take an additional 200% AoE DMG, 80% of current Combo AoE DMG, 80% of current Counter AoE DMG, and 2% of current HP AoE DMG and become stunned for 0.5s.

avians.name: Astronaut B.Duck
avians.effect: Every 16s, deals 800% Skill DMG, 320% of current Combo DMG and 320% of current Counter DMG and gains a shield equal to 10% of Max HP for 6s, during which ATK increases by 15%.

avians.name: Lunar Sprite
avians.effect: After the battle starts, the Character's DEF increases by 60% and ATK increases by 10% every 15s for 5s, during which the Character restores 3% of lost HP for every 10 basic attack or combo hits taken. (Triggers at the start of the battle.)

avians.name: Dharma
avians.effect: Every 20s after the battle starts, gains 3 stacks of Toughness (capped at 3), each of which increases DMG RES by 3.5%. For every 12% Max HP taken as DMG loses 1 stack of Toughness. (Triggers at the start of the battle.)
